start, end = 46296, 48695
# Build adjacency: for each event (u,v,t)
filtered = [e for e in events if start <= e[2] <= end]
# For faster search, group outgoing events by source node
from collections import defaultdict, deque
out_by_node = defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in filtered:
    out_by_node[u].append((t,v))
# Sort lists
for u in out_by_node:
    out_by_node[u].sort()
# BFS over temporal events starting from any event where u==303
starts = out_by_node.get(303, [])
print('starts', starts)
# For each start (t0, v0), perform BFS by visiting events where u == current node, time > current_time and time-current_time <=600
found_paths = []
for t0, v0 in starts:
    # state: (node, time, path list of (u,v,t) events)
    q = deque()
    path0 = [(303, v0, t0)]
    q.append((v0, t0, path0))
    visited = set()  # (node, time)
    while q:
        node, time_curr, path = q.popleft()
        if (node, time_curr) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((node, time_curr))
        # if node is 1293, found path
        if node == 1293:
            found_paths.append(path)
            continue
        # consider outgoing events from this node
        for t2, v2 in out_by_node.get(node, []):
            if t2 > time_curr and t2 - time_curr <= 600:
                newpath = path + [(node, v2, t2)]
                q.append((v2, t2, newpath))
# Print results
print('found_paths_count', len(found_paths))
for p in found_paths[:10]:
    print(p)
# Also, check if 1293 has any incoming events at all in window
incoming_1293 = [e for e in filtered if e[1]==1293 or e[0]==1293]
print('events involving 1293', incoming_1293)
# Print outgoing events by 1409 (first hop)
print('outgoing from 1409', out_by_node.get(1409, []) )
